newsitem.title: USA: NTN Communications service continues. [CORRECTED 20:28 GMT]
newsitem.headline: NTN Communications service continues. [CORRECTED 20:28 GMT]

text.p: NTN Communications Inc said on Monday that rumors its subscriber service had been interrupted were unfounded.

NTN said that, while it was continuing regular service, it had stopped shipping its new system of interactive keyboards to comply with a Federal Communications Commission order, (corrects by removing reference to television broadcasts because these have not been stopped).
NTN said it had been shipping its current system without realizing it had not been approved by the FCC.

The FCC was investigating the company's current interactive system to determine if it complied with agency regulations, NTN said, adding that it was still allowed to provide subscibers with regular service in the meantime.

"The company is supplying full service to our network and none of this affects our Home Services," said NTN President Dan Downes. He also said the company expected FCC approval of its current system shortly.
"Independent tests indicate that our current system is in compliance with FCC regulations," Downes said.
